ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_LP11_STOP
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Idle Stop state; LP-11 driven on both Dp and Dn; bus is free.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_LP_REQUEST
fsm_states_transmitter.description: HS-Request: drive LP-01 (Dp HIGH, Dn LOW) for T-LPX duration.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_LP_BRIDGE
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Bridge state: drive LP-00 (both LOW) for T-LPX; final LP step before HS entry.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_PREPARE
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Switch on HS driver, hold differential 0 (HS-0) for T-HS-PREPARE; receiver enables HS termination.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_ZERO
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Continue HS-0 state for T-HS-ZERO; gives receiver time to lock HS clock recovery.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_SYNC
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Transmit 8-bit Sync pattern 8'b00011101 (LSB-first on wire = 10111000) to mark start of payload.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_PAYLOAD
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Stream CSI-2 packet bytes at full HS data rate; bytes interleaved across lanes when N > 1.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_TRAIL
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Last payload bit is held for T-HS-TRAIL (~ 60 ns or 8 × UI, whichever is larger).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_HS_EXIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Disable HS driver; LP driver takes over and forces LP-11 (Stop).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_LP_ESCAPE_REQ
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Escape Request: drive LP-10 (Dp LOW, Dn HIGH) for T-LPX, then LP-00 → LP-00 → Escape pattern.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_ESC_ULPS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Ultra-Low Power State: drive LP-00 continuously; can stay indefinitely.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_ESC_TRIGGER
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Send LP escape Trigger command (4-bit code).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_ESC_RESET
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Send LP escape Reset command (force receiver to known state).

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_LP11_DETECT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Wait for LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 sequence (HS Request).

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_HS_PREP_DETECT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Enable HS receiver termination + comparator on detecting LP-00 → HS-0 transition.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_SYNC_LOCK
fsm_states_receiver.description: Hunt for Sync pattern 8'b00011101 (LSB-first 10111000); declare byte-boundary lock on match.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_HS_PAYLOAD
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample each Data Lane on both edges of Clock Lane; deinterleave across lanes; assemble byte stream.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_PACKET_DECODE
fsm_states_receiver.description: Parse 4-byte header (DI + WC + ECC), validate ECC; if Long Packet, read WC payload bytes + 2-byte CRC-16 footer; if Short Packet, packet ends after header.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_HS_TRAIL_DETECT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Detect end-of-payload via HS-Trail timing + LP-11 transition.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_LP_ESCAPE_DETECT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Detect LP-11 → LP-10 → LP-00 → LP-00 escape pattern; decode escape command.

fsm_hints.trigger: HS Entry begins when host drives LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS payload. BTA begins when host asserts TurnRequest at the end of the last packet of a transmission. TE begins when host gives bus possession to peripheral without an accompanying DSI command.
fsm_hints.rule: Packet boundaries are determined by header DT + WC fields. EoTp (when enabled) provides a robust packet-stream terminator independent of D-PHY EoT. BTA uses LP Escape Mode only and is restricted to Data Lane 0.
fsm_hints.abort: Multi-bit ECC errors lose packet boundary for the rest of the transmission (per §8.9.5 / §9.5). HS RX Timeout expiry forces peripheral back to LP-RX. LP Contention triggers Annex A recovery flows (Cases 1/2/3).

anti_deadlock_rule: Required timers HRX_TO (HS RX Timeout, peripheral), HTX_TO (HS TX Timeout, host), LTX-P_TO (LP TX Peripheral Timeout), LRX-H_TO (LP RX Host Timeout) ensure the bus returns to LP-11 Stop state within bounded time after any transient fault. LRX-H_TO MUST be longer than LTX-P_TO so the peripheral has returned to LP-RX before host timer expires. Optional TA_TO (Turnaround Acknowledge Timeout) and PR_TO (Peripheral Reset Timeout) provide additional safety nets.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: Power-up sequence per §5.7: host's T_INIT_MASTER ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY. Host drives LP-11 on all Lanes throughout T_INIT_MASTER. Peripheral powers up in RX-Stop, ignores all Link states until T_INIT_SLAVE elapses (R-C timer with ±30% accuracy is acceptable), then enters PERIPH_RX_STOP. Default Maximum Return Packet Size = 1 at this point.

default_ready_state_recommendation.Clock_Lane_idle: LP-11 (Stop state) between HS bursts when Non-Continuous Clock Mode is selected; HS-0 in Continuous Clock Mode.
default_ready_state_recommendation.Data_Lane_idle: LP-11 (Stop state) when host has bus possession and no traffic; LP-RX when peripheral has bus possession.

lane_states_table.meaning: Bridge before HS / Escape entry; also Escape Mode signaling
HS differential zero (during HS-Prepare / HS-Zero / payload bit '0')

configurations.name: Continuous Clock Mode
configurations.description: Clock Lane stays in HS continuously.

configurations.name: Non-Continuous Clock Mode
configurations.description: Clock Lane returns to LP-11 between HS bursts.

configurations.name: EoTp enabled
configurations.description: EoTp Short Packet appended at end of every HS transmission.

timing_dependency_rule: Source drives the Clock Lane DDR — receiver uses both edges to latch one Data-Lane bit each. Sync pattern (8'b00011101 LSB-first) byte-aligns the receiver. Sink's HS receiver must terminate (100 Ω differential) within T-HS-PREPARE so the eye is clean by Sync time.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_LP11_IDLE
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: All Lanes driving LP-11 Stop state; host has bus possession; no pending transaction.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_HS_ENTRY
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host issues D-PHY HS Request sequence.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_TX_PACKET_STREAM
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host streams one or more Short/Long Packets back-to-back on HS payload.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_TX_EOTP
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: If EoTp enabled, host appends Short Packet DI=0x08, payload=0x0F0F, ECC=0x01.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_BTA_REQUEST
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host asserts TurnRequest after transmission expecting response; PHY drives BTA escape.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_LP_RX_WAIT
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host has handed bus to peripheral; LRX-H_TO running.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_LP_RX_DECODE
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host receives Acknowledge / Error Report / Read Response / TE in LP on Data Lane 0.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_BTA_RETURN
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Peripheral has issued its BTA; host re-acquires bus.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_INIT_DRIVE_LP11
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Power-on: host drives sustained LP-11 for T_INIT_MASTER.

fsm_states_host_protocol.name: HOST_CONTENTION_RECOVERY
fsm_states_host_protocol.description: Host detected LP Contention; LP TX → STOP; ErrContention; optional Reset Entry.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_RX_STOP
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral in LP-RX, all Lanes idle LP-11; waiting for SoT.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_RX_HS_PAYLOAD
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral receiving HS payload; parsing DI + WC + ECC + payload + Checksum.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_RX_EOTP_DETECT
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral detects EoTp Short Packet regardless of HS or LP transmission mode.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_ERROR_ACCUMULATE
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral updates internal 16-bit Error Register without clearing.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_BTA_ACQUIRED
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: BTA received; peripheral now has bus possession; LTX-P_TO running.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_LP_TX_RESPONSE
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral transmits Acknowledge (0x21) or Acknowledge and Error Report (DT=0x02) or Read Response in LP.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_BTA_RETURN
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral hands bus back to host via own TurnRequest → BTA.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_TE_TX
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Command Mode peripheral sends LP Escape trigger byte 0x5D for Tearing Effect, then BTA.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_INIT_RX_STOP
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral powers up in RX-Stop, ignores all Link states for T_INIT_SLAVE.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_HS_RX_TIMEOUT
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: HRX_TO expired during HS RX; peripheral transitions to LP-RX.

fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.name: PERIPH_RESET_RECEIVED
fsm_states_peripheral_protocol.description: Peripheral received Reset Entry command via LP Escape Mode; executes reset; PR_TO running.

lane_states_table_inherited_from_d_phy.meaning: Bridge state before HS / Escape entry
